SELECT
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `amt`
FROM orders AS orders
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM customers AS customers
    INNER JOIN regions AS customers__regions
      ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
    INNER JOIN region_events AS customers__regions__region_events
      ON customers__regions.id = customers__regions__region_events.region_id
    WHERE
      orders.customer_id = customers.id
      AND CAST(customers__regions.pop + customers__regions__region_events.value AS FLOAT64) > 0
  )

positive/assoc_region_name::bigquery:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS `customers___regions___name`,
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `amt`
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__customers__spend_sum AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS `regions__name`,
    CAST(SUM(customers.spend) AS FLOAT64) AS `spend_sum`
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base.`customers___regions___name`,
  _base.`amt`,
  _cm_orders__customers__spend_sum.`spend_sum` AS `csp`
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__spend_sum
  ON _base.`customers___regions___name` IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__spend_sum.`regions__name`
ORDER BY
  _base.`customers___regions___name` ASC NULLS LAST
